facts.fact: Immigration PS Belio Kipsang told MPs that the unique personal identifier given at birth would become the child's national ID number at 18 and that a registered death would remove the record from active identification systems, with civil registration integration to the Health ministry system targeted within 30 days (Daily Nation).

Immigration PS Belio Kipsang told MPs that electronic birth notification feeding the new digital registration system has been piloted in Nairobi City County and Bomet County, with nationwide rollout to follow (Daily Nation).
